item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 21 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 21 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 15 August 2026(Saturday)

Light to moderate rains are expected over Pampanga(Lubao, Macabebe, Floridablanca, Sasmuan, Masantol), Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Calatagan) and Cavite(Ternate, Maragondon).

Light to moderate rains affecting Zambales(San Antonio, Castillejos, Subic, Olongapo, San Narciso), Bataan(Morong), Rizal(Rodriguez, Antipolo, San Mateo), Quezon(General Nakar), Bulacan(Norzagaray, San Jose del Monte) and Metro Manila(Quezon City) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
